name: Angi Pros API
description:
REST API to retrieve a ranked list of service professionals ("pros") for a given service/category and location.

## Authentication
This API requires **Bearer Token** authentication. Include your API key in the Authorization header of every request.

- Header Name: `Authorization`
- Format: `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>`

> Note: Authentication method may change in the future.
